directory.title: Vendor directory
directory.createHelp: Pick a company the org already deals with, or type a new company name. New vendors start as prospects.
directory.existingHelp: Leave as New company to record a company the org has not dealt with before.
directory.nameHelp: Needed only for a new company.
directory.empty: No vendors yet. Add the first vendor to start sourcing and ordering.
directory.emptyRead: No vendors are recorded yet. Vendor managers add them here.
directory.noClassesYet: No vendor classes exist yet. Create them under Vendors, Classes.
directory.gone: This vendor no longer exists or you no longer have access to it.
directory.noCompliance: No insurance certificates or prequalifications yet. Record a certificate to start.
directory.noProducts: No products recorded for this vendor. Add them from the procurement catalog.
directory.countryHelp: Two-letter country code, for example US or CA. After you save, the fields follow that country's address format.

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.empty: No bank accounts on file. People with bank detail access add them here.
bank.numberHelp: Encrypted and stored as Restricted data; only people with banking access see it in full.

classes.title: Vendor classes
classes.empty: No vendor classes yet. Add a class, or adopt one from the XOS Standard Library.
classes.emptyRead: No vendor classes yet. Vendor managers add them here.
classes.standardHelp: Adopting a Standard Library class keeps the org aligned with canon.
classes.deleteBody: Vendors keep their other classes. The class can be recreated later.

prequalification.title: Prequalification
prequalification.empty: No prequalifications yet. Request one before a vendor bids on regulated work.
prequalification.emptyRead: No prequalifications yet. Vendor managers request them here.
prequalification.scopeHelp: What the vendor is being prequalified for, for example rigging over 2,000 kg.
prequalification.decideBody: A decision is final. A new request is needed to change it later.

certificates.title: Insurance certificates
certificates.empty: No insurance certificates on file. Record one when a vendor sends its certificate.
certificates.emptyRead: No insurance certificates on file yet.
certificates.coverageHelp: For example General Liability or Workers Compensation.
certificates.documentHelp: Link to the stored certificate file.
certificates.deleteBody: It leaves the list and the vendor's compliance; the audit log keeps the record.

scorecards.title: Scorecards
scorecards.empty: No scorecards yet. Score a vendor at the end of a project or period.
scorecards.emptyVendor: No scores for this vendor yet.
scorecards.deleteBody: The scores leave the vendor's history; the audit log keeps the record.

entitlements.title: Sponsor entitlements
entitlements.empty: No sponsor entitlements yet. Add what each sponsor is owed so gate 8 can be evidenced.
entitlements.quantityHelp: Leave blank when the entitlement is not countable, such as naming rights.
entitlements.deleteBody: It leaves the list and the proof of performance; the audit log keeps the record.

assets.title: Brand assets
assets.empty: No brand assets yet. Add the logo, artwork or copy this entitlement needs.

deliveries.title: Deliveries and proof
deliveries.empty: No deliveries recorded. Record each delivery and attach photos as proof of performance.
deliveries.quantityHelp: Leave blank when the delivery is not counted.

refusals.vendor_blocked: A blocked or canceled vendor takes no new purchase orders. Activate the vendor first.
refusals.vendor_transition_not_allowed: That vendor move is not allowed from the current state.
refusals.vendor_state_conflict: Someone changed this vendor's state first. Refresh and try again.
refusals.transition_reason_required: Every state change needs a reason.
refusals.counterparty_name_required: Enter the company's name to add a new vendor.
refusals.prequalification_decided: This prequalification is already decided. Request a new one to change it.
refusals.prequalification_decide_rpc: Decide prequalifications with the Approve and Reject buttons.
refusals.sod_approval_requester: Separation of duties: the person who requested this cannot decide it.
refusals.bank_account_vendor_immutable: A bank account stays with its vendor.
refusals.bank_account_details: Enter the bank and the account holder, each in 200 characters or fewer.
refusals.bank_account_number_format: An account number has 4 to 34 letters and digits.
refusals.bank_routing_number_format: A routing number has 34 letters and digits or fewer.
refusals.bank_account_rpc_only: Add bank details with the bank account form, which encrypts the numbers.
refusals.supplier_diversity_not_shared: This certification is no longer shared with your organization.
refusals.certificate_reveal_reason: Write why you need the certificate number, in at least 10 characters.
refusals.certificate_number_missing: No certificate number is on file for this certification.
refusals.sponsor_asset_transition_not_allowed: That asset move is not allowed from the current state.
refusals.entitlement_delivery_immutable: A delivery keeps its entitlement and the person who recorded it.
refusals.review_decide_rpc: Approve or return assets with the review buttons.
refusals.cross_org_reference: That item belongs to another organization.
refusals.insureds_none_required: The organization requires no additional insureds for this project. Add them under Required insureds first.
refusals.insureds_vendor_only: Additional insureds are checked for vendors. This party is not a vendor of the organization.
refusals.postal_code_invalid: That postal code does not fit the country. Check it against the address, or correct the country.

insureds.title: Additional insureds
insureds.verified: Names every additional insured the organization requires.
insureds.missing: {count, plural, one {Misses # required additional insured.} other {Misses # required additional insureds.}}
insureds.empty: No additional insureds recorded. Add each party the certificate names.
insureds.emptyRead: No additional insureds recorded on this certificate.
insureds.name: Party named
insureds.nameHelp: As the certificate prints it, for example the venue owner.
insureds.requiredSentence: Every vendor certificate must name these parties. A project requirement adds to the organization-wide ones for vendors engaged on that project.
insureds.requiredEmpty: No required insureds yet. Add the parties every vendor certificate must name.
insureds.requiredEmptyRead: The organization requires no additional insureds yet.
insureds.requiredNameHelp: The party vendors must name, for example the venue owner.

diversity.title: Supplier diversity
diversity.lead: Certifications vendors and freelancers shared with your organization for its supplier diversity program. Each was shared by separate consent and can be revoked; every view is logged.
diversity.off: Your organization runs no supplier diversity program, so nobody can share diversity certifications with it.
diversity.empty: Nobody has shared a supplier diversity certification yet.
diversity.revealLead: The whole number needs a reason and your second factor. The certificate's owner sees who revealed it and why in their access log.
diversity.revealReasonHelp: Why you need the whole number, in at least 10 characters.
diversity.revealed: Certificate number: {number}. It is shown once and not kept on this page.
